exercises.title: The Josephus circle on a circular linked list
concepts: keeping the node before the current one
exercises.problemHtml:
n people numbered 1..n sit in a circle; counting starts at person 1 and every k-th person leaves. Complete static String play(int n, int k): build a circular list of CNodes, then repeatedly count k − 1 steps and unlink the next person. Return the leaving order followed by the survivor: play(7, 3) → "3 6 2 7 5 1 | survivor 4".

Keep a pointer to the node before the person who will leave, so removing is one assignment. Total work O(n·k).

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 300,000 people, k = 3) inside a 3-second limit. An O(n·k) solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(n²) (walking from the start for every removal) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. The limit is generous on purpose — if it fails, the algorithm is the problem, not your machine.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Use CNode — no java.util collections, no arrays (rule R1).
  • Output format exactly "a b c … | survivor s" (with n = 1: "| survivor 1").
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
n người đánh số 1..n ngồi thành vòng; đếm bắt đầu từ người 1 và cứ người thứ k thì rời vòng. Hoàn thiện static String play(int n, int k): dựng danh sách vòng các CNode, rồi lặp: đếm k − 1 bước và gỡ người kế tiếp. Trả về thứ tự rời vòng kèm người sống sót: play(7, 3) → "3 6 2 7 5 1 | survivor 4".

Giữ con trỏ tới nút đứng trước người sẽ rời vòng, để việc gỡ chỉ là một phép gán. Tổng công O(n·k).

⏱ Kiểm độ phức tạp. Một ca chạy code của bạn với input LỚN (n = 300,000 people, k = 3) trong hạn 3 giây. Lời giải O(n·k) xong trong chưa tới một giây trên laptop bình thường; bản O(n²) (walking from the start for every removal) cần lâu hơn rất nhiều và ca in TOO SLOW. Hạn đặt rộng có chủ ý — trượt ca này thì do thuật toán, không phải do máy bạn.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: n − 1 removals, each after k − 1 steps: O(n·k) time, and every removal is O(1) because prev is already the node before. An array or ArrayList would also have to shift or skip removed people — the ring removes them for real.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: n − 1 lần gỡ, mỗi lần sau k − 1 bước: O(n·k) thời gian, và mỗi lần gỡ O(1) vì prev đã là nút đứng trước. Mảng hay ArrayList thì còn phải dời hoặc bỏ qua người đã rời — vòng liên kết gỡ họ thật sự.

mistakesJson.loi: Counting k steps instead of k − 1 — you stand ON the person who must leave, and in a singly list you cannot unlink yourself.|||Đếm k bước thay vì k − 1 — đứng NGAY trên người phải rời, mà danh sách đơn không tự gỡ chính mình được.
Starting prev at the head — the first count is shifted by one person.|||Cho prev bắt đầu ở head — lần đếm đầu lệch một người.

exercises.title: Is the linked list a palindrome? O(n) time, O(1) memory, list restored
exercises.problemHtml:
Complete static boolean isPalindrome(Node head): true when the values read the same forwards and backwards (1 2 3 2 1, 4 4, the empty list). No array, no stack, no copy (rule R1): find the middle with slow/fast pointers, reverse the second half in place, compare, then reverse it back — the grader checks that the list is exactly as it was (same node objects, same order) after the call.

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 2,000,001 nodes) inside a 3-second limit. An O(n) with loops solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an recursive or O(n²) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. The limit is generous on purpose — if it fails, the algorithm is the problem, not your machine.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • O(n) time, O(1) extra memory; no recursion.
  • The list is unchanged after the call.

exercises.title: 🎯 PE format — MyList of Cars: f1 addLast with a condition, f2 insert as 3rd, f3 delete the first max, f4 stable sort
concepts: PE project layout (Main, Lib, data.txt, f1.txt…)
singly linked list with head and tail
stable sort on a linked list
exercises.problemHtml:
Question 1 (4 marks) — a singly linked list of cars. Car(owner, price) is given, MyList keeps head and tail. This paper copies the layout of the real CSD201 papers (Main with a menu, Lib.readLineToStrArray, loadData(k), fvisit/ftraverse writing to the file) — the questions are this course’s own.

The exam format. The given project contains Main.java, Lib.java, Node.java, Car.java and MyList.java. Only MyList.java may be edited, and only where the paper allows it (part (2)): complete the functions below, keep every pre-given statement and add your statements in the marked places (you may add helper functions). Each fK() loads its own lines of data.txt, writes the answer to fK.txt, and Main prints that file. Choosing K in the menu runs fK only — exactly how the marking software runs your project, one choice per run.

  1. f1() — addLast(xOwner, xPrice): if xOwner.charAt(0) == 'B' do nothing, otherwise add a new car to the END of the list. loadData calls it for every column of the data — f2…f4 depend on it too. Paper data → (A,9) (C,6) (D,2) (E,7) (F,4).
  2. f2() — Given x = (X,1): insert x so that it becomes the 3rd node of the list; if the list has fewer than 2 nodes, add x to the end. The file gets the list before and after.
  3. f3() — Delete the first node having the maximum price (keep tail right when it is the last node).
  4. f4() — Sort the list ascending by price; cars with the same price keep their relative order (stable).

The sample outputs below are produced from the paper’s data.txt (also in the download, next to cham.mjs). The hidden cases run the same choices on other data.txt files with the same layout — code that only matches the sample (hard-coded names, positions) fails them.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 12 case(s) (8 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Edit only MyList.java, where the paper allows; Main.java, Lib.java, Node.java, Car.java stay exactly as given (rule G1).
  • No Vietnamese accents anywhere in your file(s) (rule P…) — Java 8 (javac --release 8, like the exam room’s JDK 1.8).
  • Run it like the exam: node cham.mjs runs Main once per choice 1–4 with the paper’s data.txt and with hidden data files.

  • Không có tiếng Việt có dấu ở bất kỳ đâu trong tệp của bạn (luật P…) — Java 8 (javac --release 8, như JDK 1.8 của phòng thi).
  • Chạy như phòng thi: node cham.mjs chạy Main một lần cho mỗi lựa chọn 1–4 với data.txt của đề và với các tệp dữ liệu ẩn.

solutionCodeJson.name: cham.mjs

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: f1 is the classic append with a guard; f2 walks to the 2nd node and links x after it; f3 finds the first maximum together with the node before it, then unlinks it (head and tail cases); f4 is a stable selection by shifting the infos between i and the minimum one step right instead of swapping. Every f is O(n) except f4 (O(n²), fine for a PE).
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: f1 là thêm cuối có điều kiện; f2 đi tới nút thứ 2 rồi nối x sau nó; f3 tìm max đầu tiên cùng nút đứng trước nó rồi gỡ ra (trường hợp head và tail); f4 là chọn ổn định: dời các info giữa i và nút nhỏ nhất sang phải một bước thay vì hoán đổi. Mọi f đều O(n) trừ f4 (O(n²), đủ cho PE).

mistakesJson.loi: Deleting the max that is the tail without moving tail — harmless in this file, but a following addLast would attach to a removed node (the examiners test it in other questions).|||Xoá max là nút tail mà không dời tail — trong tệp này vô hại, nhưng addLast sau đó sẽ gắn vào nút đã xoá (giám khảo kiểm ở câu khác).
Writing Vietnamese with accents in a comment — the real exam machine reports an error and gives 0 (rule P1).|||Viết tiếng Việt có dấu trong chú thích — máy chấm thật báo lỗi và cho 0 điểm (luật P1).
An unstable sort (swapping the min into place) — (I,2) jumps before (E,2).|||Sắp không ổn định (hoán đổi min vào chỗ) — (I,2) nhảy lên trước (E,2).
